newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-IVERSEN COMPLETES MOVE TO TOTTENHAM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-IVERSEN COMPLETES MOVE TO TOTTENHAM.

text.p: Norwegian international striker Steffen Iversen said on Thursday he was sad to leave Rosenborg Trondheim in the wake of their stunning European Cup triumph over AC Milan but pleased to be joining English premier league side Tottenham.

Iversen was part of the Rosenborg team which beat Milan 2-1 in the San Siro on Wednesday to knock the Italian giants out of the competition and set up an unlikely quarter-final against world club champions Juventus.
But the road to European glory this season ends there for Iversen, who had agreed to join Spurs for a Norwegian transfer record of $4.4 million before Wednesday's dramatic match.

"I could have stayed with Rosenborg and played against Juventus but Tottenham made an offer for me and, although I know many others were interested, I wanted to come here," the 20-year-old said. "I had a good impression of (Spurs manager) Gerry Francis and the club when I visited a few weeks ago.
"Also my friend from Norway Espen Baardsen is already here as reserve goalkeeper and he will help me to settle.

Francis added: "Rosenborg, naturally, still wanted to keep Steffen especially after their magnificent win over Milan but that was never on. We didn't want to wait until next March and then, of course, it could have gone on even longer with them maybe even reaching the European Cup final."
